senses: a Levite and a Gittite who kept the ark after Uzzah was slain by God for touching the ark while it was being taken to Jerusalem
a Merarite Levite and a singer and gatekeeper

strongs.def: Obed-Edom, the name of five Israelites
strongs.from: from the active participle of H5647 (עָבַד) and H123 (אֱדֹם); worker of Edom
